github_items.description: Computer use CLI for AI agents
github_items.raw_context:
# agent-desktop Computer use for AI agents: see and operate desktop apps on macOS, Windows, and Linux through the OS accessibility tree.

agent-desktop gives an AI agent computer use without screenshots or pixel matching. It reads the accessibility tree of a desktop app and returns it as JSON, with a ref for every element the agent can act on. The agent clicks or types on a ref, reads the UI again to check the result, and repeats. The loop lives in your agent; agent-desktop has no model ins

github_items.name: auto-ontology
github_items.description: Auto Ontology is a Python framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data. It enables deterministic query generation, better context retrieval, and more explainable AI for LLM and agent workflows.
github_items.raw_context: # Auto Ontology Agents can retrieve documents and query databases, but reliability gates agentic analytics: a revenue metric answered faster is worth nothing if the number is wrong. Agents need a context layer that tells them where data lives, what it means, whether to use it, how to use it, where it came from, and what is similar. NVIDIA Auto Ontology is an open library that builds that layer from enterprise metadata, reconciles definitions across systems, and exposes it to any agent harness through MCP, CLI, and API. It complements the semantic models customers already own. It enables developers to: - Discover: generate enterprise ontologies from metadata; connect existing ontologies and semantic models; build AI-ready knowledge graphs. - Ground: give agents trusted business meaning for metrics, entities, and relationships; reconcile inconsistent definitions across systems. - Validate: check generated queries against certified definitions and lineage; return provenance with every answer. - Expose: serve context to any agent harness through MCP, CLI, and API. Learn: fold certified corrections and usage back into the ontology, so shared context improves with every question. ## Benchmarks To run a text-to-SQL benchmark such as BIRD, refer to the [ontology SQL evaluation repository](https://github.com/NVIDIA/ontology-sql-eval/). > **Licensing & contributions.** Auto Ontology is d

全能的光盘盘面可见图像生成与刻录工具

Disc Image Studio 是一个多平台的光盘盘面图像生成与刻录工具，帮助您使用任何刻录光驱在任何 DVD / CD / 单层蓝光 光盘上刻蚀出肉眼可见的图像。 [](LICENSE)
--- ## 效果预览 --- ## 概述 Disc Image Studio 可将一张图片转换成符合 CD、DVD 与单层 BD-R 光盘物理层约束的数据，刻录后将使光盘盘面呈现肉眼可见的图案。 ## 界面预览 --- ## 快速开始 Windows 下载 `win-x64.exe` 后可直接运行。Linux 或 macOS 请下载与 CPU 匹配的**实验性 CLI** 压缩包，解压后运行 `./disc-image-studio --help`。这些发布包均自带 .NET 运行时。 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/releases) ### 1. 新建工程 在主页选择 CD、DVD 或蓝光，指定输出位置后创建工程。 ### 2. 设计盘面 在设计页导入图片，用图层完成排版，并在右栏「影调」模块调整抖动、伽马、亮度与灰阶档位。 ### 3. 预览与导出 在预览页核对盘面投影，在导出页生成 ISO / RAW / WAV+CUE，或使用即时刻录功能直接写入空白盘片。 即时刻录为实验性功能，请只使用可报废的测试介质。 ## 功能 ### 光盘数据生成 - **CD 支持**：支持任何 CD 。您可导出带格式头的 WAV 音轨及配套 CUE，兼容 cdrecord, ImgBurn等刻录软件；也允许导出 RAW 音轨。详见 [CD 刻录兼容说明](docs/CD_AUDIO_COMPATIBILITY.md)。 - **DVD 支持**：支持任何 DVD。您可导出 ISO 镜像。 - **蓝光支持**：支持任何单层 BD-R 25 GB，支持纯绘图与 UDF 2.01 文件。详见 [ADDING_BLURAY.md](docs/ADDING_BLURAY.md)。 - **随盘文件**：CD／DVD／蓝光可在设计页直接选择要保存的文件夹及内圈／外圈位置，也可在导出页调整；设置随工程保存。 - **文件区域预览**：混合盘的设计投影和成品读回用黄色标出文件区（含文件系统）。 - **介质灰度方案**：CD 与 DVD 均使用黑白二阶，CD 使用 `0D / AA`，DVD 扰码域使用 `A5 / 92`。详见 [PHYSICAL_MODEL_AUDIT.md](docs/PHYSICAL_MODEL_AUDIT.md)。 - **灰度抖动工具**：独立程序也可将原图处理为 `0/255` 黑白二阶 PNG；支持打开或拖入原图、并排预览
